the development of an SU8/poly (vinyl alcohol) bilayer lift off photolithographic process that can be used to fabricate top contact pentacenes based organic thin film transistor (OTFT) devices with a short channel length of 5 um.
the design and fabrication process of a top contact pentacence based organic thin film transistor (OTFT) using two-step lift-off photolithography.
